name: com.bebound.sdk.receiver.internal.ApplicationChangedReceiver
description: The Be-Bound messaging SDK receives Android broadcasts when apps are installed, updated, or removed and checks whether the changed package is Be-Bound Services. If that service package changes, it signals the host app and unregisters the messaging setup when the service is removed.
disableEffect: The SDK will not detect Be-Bound Services changes, so its automatic messaging registration and cleanup may be left out of date.
